title: Kissed with Fresh Parsley Algerian Dishes Tagine
description: A cozy Algerian dish featuring freshly chopped parsley, air-fry, and low-calorie-friendly ingredients. Serve in a banana leaf for a unique and flavorful experience.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.notes: boneless and skinless, cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to the air fryer basket and cook until cooked through, about 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the parsley, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
To serve, place a portion of the chicken mixture onto a banana leaf and top with a dollop of parsley mixture.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
